page.overview:
What is Jirachi?

Jirachi is a small and light Pokémon reminiscent of a shooting star. The lower part of Jirachi's body is white, although its yellow head makes up a large part of its body, bearing the shape of a three-pointed star, one of which points upwards and two of which protrude to the sides. A turquoise strip of paper hanging at the tip of all three points of Jirachi's head, serving as notes on which wishes can be written.

It has large, black eyes with blue stripes running down them, resembling tears. Jirachi has a hidden eye on its stomach that is normally closed and only visible as a semicircular line, although if the eye opens, one can see a yellow sclera with a green iris in the middle. Jirachi also has two small but wide arms and two long, yellow wings that resemble the ends of a gift bow.

In its Shiny form, Jirachi's white body and face are shaded reddish, and the strips of paper at the tips of its head are red.

Like most Mythical Pokémon, Jirachi's statistics are above average, having a higher Attack, Defense, and Speed. Jirachi can fight opponents while it is sleeping, using mainly -type moves. Jirachi can use physical moves such as Zen Headbutt and special moves such as Psychic and Future Sight.
